name: McLean County, ND
findings: McLean County has 33 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, McLean County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in McLean County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in McLean County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
